728-801-3249-3755.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-801-3249-3755.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

465-585-969-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

252-1251-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1251-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

586-864-3125-5632-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5632-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1263-2301-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2506-4365-7150-7752.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

4067-5672-7704.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Doc Samson.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

338-1545-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2034-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2034-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

907-1558-2638-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2638-4231-4365.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2981-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2981-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1739-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2570-3519-5531-6763.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Lumra, adding seven {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Lumra to the command zone from exile.
Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Lumra from the command zone into your hand.
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

654-681-5413-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-5413-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

2829-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

2511-3174-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-1632-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1274-3197-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6097.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-3490-6600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2757-3490-6600.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Shelinda triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it or the creature that entered the battlefield.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic land.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3443-4657.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
539-3443-4657.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

1453-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 3 until Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1846-2872-3525.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
1846-2872-3525.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat from step 2

2167-2374-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-2374-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Maja triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1003-4875-5852.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
1003-4875-5852.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Walker triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Phyrexian Walker spells, causing the nontoken Phyrexian Walker to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

751-3168-4452-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Rukarumel.
751-3168-4452-5613.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {0}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1267-5406-5407.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Brass Squire does not have summoning sickness.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
1267-5406-5407.description:
Declare any other creature as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Brass Squire by tapping it, attaching Dinosaur Headdress to the attacking creature, and causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Brass Squire.
Repeat each turn.

1039-3358-4556.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-3358-4556.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Pest, targeting Teardrop Kami.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hell's Caretaker ability, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1799-2048-4242-5147.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
1799-2048-4242-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1594-3098-3449-3809-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {1}{U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {1}{U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

717-751-1063-1742-4050.description:
Activate Skirga Familiar by discarding Shrieking Drake, adding {B}.
Oskar and Bone Miser's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {U}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, causing you to pay {U} to cast Shrieking Drake from your graveyard.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-1961-2793-5089.manaNeeded: {4} on your first turn, with {9} available each extra turn
1124-1961-2793-5089.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing a noncreature artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1636-1689-2359-2519.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1636-1689-2359-2519.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Season of Growth.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Season of Growth trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1352-1869-2034.description:
Cast Mistbind Clique by paying {3}{U}.
Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Mistbind Clique with haste.
The token Mistbind Clique enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Mistbind Clique.
The nontoken Mistbind Clique leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Mistbind Clique trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding {C}{C}.
The Mistbind Clique token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Mistbind Clique from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-4300-5196.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card on the battlefield that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4300-5196.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
The Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

339-677-876-2034.notablePrerequisites: Lightning Greaves is attached to Jegantha.
339-677-876-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar sacrificing Jegantha, adding {C}{C} Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Jegantha.
Repeat.

101-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Vampire Charmseeker.
101-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
The Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
